title: The Matomic Building, Project AQUATONE headquarters, Chapter 2 p. 42
description: Black-and-white street-level photograph of a multistory office building with rows of windows, trees and parked cars in the foreground, captioned "The Matomic Building." Accompanying text recounts the project staff's moves around Washington, ending with a move in February 1956 to the fifth floor of the Matomic Building at 1717 H Street, NW.
